name: infer-conventions
title_zh: 一份会随代码库长大的「我们这儿这么写」活文档
tagline_zh: 代码风格打架时，它能从现有代码里推断出你们真正在用的写法，生成 .ai/rules。
tagline_en: When styles clash, it infers your real conventions from existing code and writes .ai/rules, so newcomers and.
desc_en: Use this skill to analyze how a Laravel application is actually written and record its conventions as shared rules. Trigger when the user wants to detect, infer, document, or standardize project conventions or coding style, set up or grow `.ai/rules`, resolve mixed or conflicting patterns (e.g. \"are we using Form Requests or inline validation?\"), or onboard agents and teammates to \"how we do th
why_zh: 不是问你怎么写，而是读你实际怎么写的——从提交和文件里归纳。
why_en: It doesn't ask—it reads your actual commits and files to infer implicit choices like Form Requests vs inline validation, then.
limit_zh: 只认 Laravel/PHP 项目；需要可读的 git 历史；产出的是规则文本，不自动重构代码。
limit_en: Laravel/PHP only; needs readable git history; outputs rule text, not refactored code; if codebase is chaotically inconsistent, inferences will be off.
title_en: A living 'how we write code here' doc that grows with your.
